narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The sum is five point one two, since seven and five make twelve.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But five point one two has one tenth and two hundredths, which is far too small.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Twelve tenths cannot sit in the tenths place.
